program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20, 12, 24),        # input pair gm/Id (larger W -> lower flicker, lower Vgs -> tail headroom)
    "L1":    (3.0, 1.0, 5.0),     # input pair L (area for flicker)
    "Itail": (32e-6, 16e-6, 60e-6),
    "Cc":    (3.0e-12, 1.5e-12, 5e-12),
    "I6":    (90e-6, 40e-6, 160e-6),
    "gmid6": (10, 7, 14),
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # NMOS bias mirrors L
    "rzk":   (1.6, 0.8, 3.0),     # Rz = rzk*(1+CL/Cc)/gm6 scaling
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2
    Lb = p["Lb"]
    # NMOS bias: tail sized for low Vdsat (headroom below input-pair source)
    gmidt = 14.0
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidt, Lb, Iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidt, Lb, It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidt, Lb, I6, vds=0.9)
    # input pair: high gm/Id, long L -> big gate area, low flicker
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5)
    # PMOS mirror load: moderate gm/Id (keeps Vsg ~ same), long L for low flicker
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, 2.0, I1, vds=1.1)
    # second stage PMOS CS
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], 1.0, I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rzk"] * (1 + CL / Cc) / m6.gm
    Rz = max(Rz, 1.2 / m6.gm)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M8", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.R("Rz", "vout", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "nz", "n1", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    p3 = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd) / (2 * PI)
    zden = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    if zden > 0:
        z = 1 / (2 * PI * zden)
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
        p4 = 1 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
        pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p4))
    slew = 0.65 * min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))   # calibrated vs sim (0.64)
    swing = 1.8 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.05
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    thermal2 = 16 * kT / (3 * m1.gm) * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm)
    # flicker ~ 1/(gate area) ~ 1/cgg ; calibrated Kf from iteration 1 (~275nV with cgg1~0.3pF)
    Kf = 1.5e-13
    flick2 = (Kf ** 2) / m1.cgg * (1 + 0.3 * (m3.gm / m1.gm) ** 2 * m1.cgg / m3.cgg)
    noise = math.sqrt(thermal2 + flick2)
    power = 1.8 * (Iref + It + I6)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise, "power": power}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS output, Rz-Cc)
